title: The Dinosaur Who Loved Ice Cream
description: A playful podcast-style video where we explore the quirky tale of a dinosaur who adored ice cream, featuring interviews, expert quotes, and fun facts.
thumbnailPrompt: A friendly T-Rex holding an oversized scoop of vanilla ice cream against a warm orange studio backdrop with soft purple lighting

scenes.title: Welcome to DinoDelights!
scenes.imagePrompt: Studio set with a cozy podcast desk, warm orange lights, and a dark purple backdrop. A microphone sits on the table.

audio.text: Hey everyone, welcome back to DinoDelights! I'm your host, Maya, and today we’re diving into the coolest story ever—how a dinosaur ended up loving ice cream. Stay tuned for some prehistoric scoops of fun!

scenes.title: Meet Dr. Lila Stone, Paleoculinary Expert
scenes.imagePrompt: An animated profile spotlight of Dr. Lila Stone with a lab coat and dinosaur bones in the background.

elements.name: Dr. Lila Stone
elements.title: Paleoculinary Scientist
elements.description: Dr. Stone studies what prehistoric creatures might have eaten—and she’s got a sweet tooth for dessert!

audio.text: Joining us today is Dr. Lila Stone, the world’s leading paleoculinary scientist. Dr. Stone, can you tell us how a T‑rex could possibly enjoy ice cream?

scenes.title: "Ice Cream Was the First Sweet Treat!"
scenes.imagePrompt: An expert quote overlay with a stylized dinosaur silhouette in the background.

elements.quote: "Ice cream was the first sweet treat discovered by dinosaurs, especially during the late Cretaceous period when frozen fruits were abundant."
elements.author: Dr. Lila Stone

audio.text: "Ice cream was the first sweet treat discovered by dinosaurs, especially during the late Cretaceous period when frozen fruits were abundant," says Dr. Stone.

scenes.title: Interview with Dino Fan: Timmy
scenes.imagePrompt: An interview scene with a child wearing a dinosaur costume, holding a toy ice cream cone.

elements.title: Interview with Dino Fan: Timmy
elements.quote: "I think the T‑rex loved it because it was cold and creamy—just like a giant, crunchy snack!"
elements.speaker: Timmy

audio.text: We’re here with 8-year-old Timmy, who swears his dad’s dinosaur plush loves ice cream. Timmy, tell us why you think a T‑rex would go for dessert.

scenes.title: The Dino Ice Cream Experiment
scenes.imagePrompt: A case study layout with a graph showing dinosaur ice cream consumption stats and a conclusion box.

elements.title: The Dino Ice Cream Experiment
elements.subtitle: What Happens When You Serve Ice Cream to Dinosaurs?
elements.statistics: 10,000 trials → 87% of dinosaurs show signs of happiness; 13% prefer chocolate over vanilla.
elements.conclusion: Ice cream isn’t just tasty—it’s a mood booster for prehistoric pals!

audio.text: Our latest experiment? We offered ice cream to 10,000 dinosaur replicas and recorded their reactions. The results were clear: 87% of them seemed happier with a scoop in hand. Looks like even ancient giants had dessert cravings!
